column1: [A11Y] | Souscription | Interactive components | Personal details[button "Continue"]: No accessible name
column12:
h1. Flow(s) / Screen(s) / Element(s) in concern
Offers -> Personal details
Personal details[button "Continue"]

h1. Actual behavior / Impact
The screen reader announces "button" only on the arrow button that goes to the next step. The icon has no text alternative.
Impact: screen reader users cannot know what the button does.

h1. Expected behavior
"Continue, button".

h1. Recommendations
- Give the button an accessible name matching its purpose.
- Prefer a native button.

h1. Reference
- RAWeb 1.1, Criterion 11.9: In each form, is the label of each button relevant (excluding special cases)?
  https://accessibilite.public.lu/en/raweb1.1/criteres.html#crit-11-9

column1: [A11Y] | Souscription | Colors & contrast | All.footer[links]: Insufficient contrast
column12:
h1. Flow(s) / Screen(s) / Element(s) in concern
All.footer[links]

h1. Actual behavior / Impact
The footer links are light grey on white (ratio about 2.9:1).
Impact: low vision users cannot read the links.

h1. Expected behavior
Text contrast of at least 4.5:1.

h1. Recommendations
- Darken the link color.

h1. Reference
- RAWeb 1.1, Criterion 3.2: On each web page, is the contrast between the colour of the text and the colour of its background sufficiently high (excluding special cases)?
  https://accessibilite.public.lu/en/raweb1.1/criteres.html#crit-3-2

column1: [A11Y] | Souscription | Forms | Personal details[field "Email"]: Error not linked to field
column12:
h1. Flow(s) / Screen(s) / Element(s) in concern
Offers -> Personal details
Personal details[field "Email"] (error)

h1. Actual behavior / Impact
After continuing with an invalid email, the error message appears under the field but is not linked to it. The screen reader does not announce it on the field.
Impact: screen reader users do not know why they cannot continue.

h1. Expected behavior
The error is announced with the field.

h1. Recommendations
- Link the error message to the field.

h1. Reference
- RAWeb 1.1, Criterion 11.10: In each form, is the error management used appropriately (excluding special cases)?
  https://accessibilite.public.lu/en/raweb1.1/criteres.html#crit-11-10

column1: [A11Y] | Souscription | Navigation & structure | Payment[dialog "Billing address"]: Focus leaves the dialog
column12:
h1. Flow(s) / Screen(s) / Element(s) in concern
Personal details -> Payment
Payment[dialog "Billing address"] (open)

h1. Actual behavior / Impact
With the dialog open, Tab moves the focus to the page behind the dialog.
Impact: keyboard users lose the dialog and cannot finish the subscription.

h1. Expected behavior
Focus stays in the dialog until it closes.

h1. Recommendations
- Keep the focus inside the dialog while it is open.

h1. Reference
- RAWeb 1.1, Criterion 12.8: On each web page, is the navigation sequence consistent?
  https://accessibilite.public.lu/en/raweb1.1/criteres.html#crit-12-8

column1: [A11Y] | Souscription | Images & media | Home; Offers: Offer banner without text alternative
column12:
h1. Flow(s) / Screen(s) / Element(s) in concern
Home[image "Spring offer"]
Offers[image "Spring offer"]

h1. Actual behavior / Impact
The offer banner has no text alternative. The screen reader reads the file name "banner_v3_final.jpg".
Impact: blind users miss the discount on the first months.

h1. Expected behavior
The alternative gives the offer text.

h1. Recommendations
- Give the image a text alternative with the offer.

h1. Reference
- RAWeb 1.1, Criterion 1.1: Does each image conveying information have a text alternative?
  https://accessibilite.public.lu/en/raweb1.1/criteres.html#crit-1-1

column12:

column1: [A11Y] | Souscription | Navigation & structure | Account[link "Edit"]: Link purpose unclear
column12:
h1. Flow(s) / Screen(s) / Element(s) in concern
Account[link "Edit"]

h1. Actual behavior / Impact
Three links are named "Edit" with no context in their name.
Impact: screen reader users listing links cannot tell them apart.

h1. Expected behavior
"Edit address", "Edit email"...

h1. Recommendations
- Make each link name explicit.

h1. Reference
- RAWeb 1.1, Criterion 6.1: Is every link explicit (except in special cases)?
  https://accessibilite.public.lu/en/raweb1.1/criteres.html#crit-6-1

column1: [A11Y] | Souscription | Content & readability | Plan details[table "Price comparison"]: Headers not associated
column12:
h1. Flow(s) / Screen(s) / Element(s) in concern
Plan details[table "Price comparison"]

h1. Actual behavior / Impact
The column headers are styled cells, not headers. The screen reader reads the prices without the plan name.
Impact: screen reader users cannot tell which price belongs to which plan.

h1. Expected behavior
Each cell announced with its header.

h1. Recommendations
- Mark the header cells as headers.

h1. Reference
- RAWeb 1.1, Criterion 5.7: For each data table, is the appropriate technique used to associate each cell with its headers (excluding special cases)?
  https://accessibilite.public.lu/en/raweb1.1/criteres.html#crit-5-7

column1: [A11Y] | Souscription | Forms | Personal details[field "Postal code"]: Purpose not identified
column12:
h1. Flow(s) / Screen(s) / Element(s) in concern
Personal details[field "Postal code"]

h1. Actual behavior / Impact
The browser does not offer autofill for the postal code field: its purpose is not identified.
Impact: users with motor or cognitive disabilities must type everything.

h1. Expected behavior
Autofill available.

h1. Recommendations
- Identify the purpose of the field.

h1. Reference
- RAWeb 1.1, Criterion 11.13: Can the purpose of an input field be identified to facilitate the automatic filling of fields with user data?
  https://accessibilite.public.lu/en/raweb1.1/criteres.html#crit-11-13

column1: [A11Y] | Souscription | Navigation & structure | Personal details: No progress indicator
column12:
h1. Flow(s) / Screen(s) / Element(s) in concern
Offers -> Personal details -> Payment -> Confirmation
Personal details

h1. Actual behavior / Impact
The subscription has four steps but nothing shows the current step or how many remain.
Impact: users with cognitive disabilities do not know where they are in the subscription.

h1. Expected behavior
A step indicator: "Step 2 of 4".

h1. Recommendations
- Show the current step and the total.

h1. Reference
No RAWeb criterion: usability issue.
Upgrade the SDK before the end of the sprint.

column1: [A11Y] | Souscription | Navigation & structure | Offers[link "Compare offers"]: Focus not visible
[A11Y] | Souscription | Navigation & structure | All.header[link "Skip to content"]: Link missing
column12:
h1. Flow(s) / Screen(s) / Element(s) in concern
All.header

h1. Actual behavior / Impact
There is no skip link: the keyboard user goes through the 25 menu links on every screen.
Impact: keyboard users waste time on every screen.

A "Skip to content" link first in the page.

h1. Recommendations
- Add a skip link.

h1. Reference
- RAWeb 1.1, Criterion 12.7: On each web page, is there a bypass or skip link to the main content region (excluding special cases)?
